testScenarios.detailedSteps: 1. Press and hold pairing button for 5 seconds.Verify: LED is blinking white when the headphones are in pairing mode.

1. Observe the pairing LED on the headphones.Verify: Pairing LED is Off.2. Press and hold the pairing button for more than 5 seconds.Verify: The Pairing LED blinks slowly (Pairing Mode).3. Wait up to 10 minutes.Verify: The Pairing LED is no longer blinking.

1. Press and hold power button to put headphones into Pairing Mode.Verify: Ready to pair audio plays through headphones.2. Go to Settings -> Devices -> Bluetooth and other devices.3. Select 'Add Bluetooth or other device'.4. Select Bluetooth.5. Select headphones to pair.Verify: The headphones pair.

1. Remove Device Surface Headhpones from BT menu if connected.
2. Hold down pairing button from 5 seconds.
Verify: DUT prompts Surface Headphones pairing option.
3. Connect headphones via pairing prompt
Verify: Headphones pair to DUT in BT menu

1. Pair the audio device to the host.
2. Go to Settings -> Devices -> Bluetooth and other devices.
3. Select the audio device.
4. Select Remove Device.
Verify: The device is removed.

1. Pair the audio device to the host.

testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Download and launch Surface App from MS Store.
Verify: DUT prompts LE connection for use with Office Apps. (If Surface App is already downloaded, launch and turn on Microsoft 365 integration from Device controls menu) 
2. Accept prompts to pair via LE Connection.
3. Open BlueTooth menu.
Verify: LE Surface Headphones are connected under Other devices and battery% is visible.

1. Test touch commands on each side 
-Tap once/Play or Pause
-Tap twice/Skip a song
-Tap Three times/Previous song
Verify: Touch commands work correctly on each headphone

1. Rotate the left dial
Verify: Noise cancellation activates when scrolling forwards/turning off backwards

1. With audio playing through headphones, rotate the right headphone dial
Verify: Turning dial forward increases volume/turning backwards lowers volume

1. Connect 3.5mm audio cable to Surface Headphones 
 Verify: Audio playback through Headphones
1. Connect USB-C charging cable to Surface Headphones Verify: Headphones are charging Verify: Bluetooth/Audio cable playback while charging

testScenarios.detailedSteps: 1. Wear headphones and have audio playing through headphones.2. Remove heaphones.Verify: Playback pauses.3. Wear headphones.Verify: Playback resumes.
1. Wear Headphones and open Microsoft Word.2. In the Home tab select 'Dictate'3. Begin speaking.Verify: Text matches what you have said.
1. Pair headphones to the Host.2. Place the Host into CS.3. Wait for 30 seconds.4. Wake Host.Verify: Headphones are connected and respond to tap commands.
1. Pair the audio device to the Host.2. Place the Host into CS.3. Wait for 5 minutes.4. Wake Host.Verify: Audio device is connected and responds to tap commands.
1. Pair the audio device to the Host.2. Restart Host.3. Wait for 30 seconds.4. Wake Host.Verify: Audio device is connected and responds to tap commands.
1. Pair the audio device to the Host.2. Hibernate Host..3. Wait for 30 seconds.4. Wake Host.Verify: Audio device is connected and responds to tap commands.
1. Pair the audio device to the Host.2. Shutdown Host.3. Wait for 30 seconds.4. Wake Host.Verify: Audio device is connected and responds to tap commands.

1. Pair earbuds to DUT.
2. Place earbuds in charging case and leave lid open.
Verify: Charging case LED turns off after 5 min.
3. Remove earbuds from charging case and leave lid open.
Verify: Charging case LED turns off after 5 min.

1. Pair earbuds to DUT.
2. Place one earbud in charging case.
Verify: Case LED blinks white

1. Pair earbuds to DUT.
2. Place one earbud in charging case rotated 180 degress from correct orientation.
Verify: Case LED blinks red

With Earbuds paired, selected, and powered on:
1. Wear Earbuds and have audio playing through earbuds.
2. Swipe up on the right earbud.
Verify: Volume increases.
3. Swipe down on the right earbud.
Verify: Volume decreases.

With Earbuds paired, selected, and powered on:
1. Wear Earbuds and have audio playing through earbuds.
2. Swipe the left earbud forward.
Verify: Next track is played.
3. Swipe the left earbud backward.
Verify: Previous track is played.

With Earbuds paired, selected, and powered on:
1. Wear Earbuds and have audio playing through earbuds.
2. perform tap and swipe gestures.
Verify: Earbuds play a tone for each gesture performed.

1. Open the Surface Audio App (Start Menu -> Surface Audio)
2. Select 'Device controls'
3. De-select 'Touch control.
Verify: performing Gestures on the Earbuds no longer controls audio playback.

With Earbuds paired, selected, and powered on:
1. Place Earbuds in charging case.
Verify: Device is shown as 'Disconnected' in the Surface App.
2. Remove Eabuds from charging case.
Verify: Device is shown as 'Connected' in the Surface App.
